test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BLOCK' is coded as LBCON and 'CABIN' is coded as ACIBQ. How will 'SUITE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**'**BLOCK**' **is coded as 'LBCON**',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/623dee2dd4fc3cfed2430ce670e238007088ce24612a5f64b0d5dc6401d19822.png] 

'CABIN' is coded as 'ACIBQ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eb0a4ff466393bccd986b7b033cb15328acdea6411e0cd61b91f0c1ad062f4c.png] 

Similarly, for SUITE:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31aae702833d00f42d0ead0f6e51b87bd2453f2bf41108d4df9cd7c9d5e70071.png] 

So, 'SUITE' will be coded as '**USTIH**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
